description: Governed reproduction state labels. Guarded reproduction ends in exactly one terminal label; every other governed label is removed in the same reconciliation.

labels.name: repro-in-progress
labels.description: Guarded reproduction is running for this issue

labels.name: repro-confirmed
labels.description: Guarded execution reproduced the reported defect

labels.name: repro-not-reproduced
labels.description: Guarded execution matched the reported expectation

labels.name: repro-blocked
labels.description: Guarded reproduction was blocked by readiness, policy, limits, or infrastructure

labels.name: repro-needs-review
labels.description: Guarded execution completed but the outcome needs maintainer adjudication
